title: Chartered Accountant
description:
Company Description CMRS & Associates LLP (formerly Chandrakant G. Doshi & Co.) is a Chartered Accountancy firm with over 50 years of experience in audit and assurance services. The firm provides a comprehensive range of professional services under one roof, including taxation, accounting, auditing, and consultation across Income Tax, GST, Sales Tax, and Service Tax. CMRS & Associates LLP also serves MSMEs, conducts internal audits, and undertakes specialized audits aligned with current regulatory and industry requirements. The firm has built a trusted client base across diverse industry sectors, offering long-term, relationship-driven professional support.

Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Chartered Accountant role based in Pimpri Chinchwad. The Chartered Accountant will manage statutory, tax, and internal audits, including planning, execution, documentation, and finalization of reports and financial statements. Responsibilities include preparing and reviewing financial statements, tax computations, and returns (Income Tax, GST, TDS), as well as supporting tax assessments and representations. The role involves performing analytical reviews, ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards and tax laws, and advising clients on financial, tax, and regulatory matters. The Chartered Accountant will coordinate with clients to gather information, resolve queries, maintain working papers, and contribute to process improvements within the firm.

Qualifications

Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with valid membership in the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).

Strong knowledge of accounting standards, auditing standards, and financial reporting principles.

Hands-on experience in direct and indirect taxation, including Income Tax, GST, TDS, and related compliances.

Experience in statutory audit, internal audit, and tax audit for SMEs/MSMEs and/or larger enterprises.

Proficiency in accounting and audit tools (e.g., Tally, MS Excel, and other relevant audit software).

Ability to interpret and apply relevant tax laws, rules, and notifications to practical client situations.

Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and accuracy.

Effective written and verbal communication skills for client interaction, reporting, and documentation.

Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and work collaboratively within a team.

Prior experience in a CA firm or professional services environment is preferred.

**Job Description**

Position Summary

The role is Responsible for managing the organization's direct and indirect tax compliance, tax planning, tax reporting, and regulatory requirements. The role ensures adherence to applicable tax laws, minimizes tax risks, optimizes tax positions, and supports business operations through effective tax advisory and governance. The incumbent liaises with tax authorities, auditors, consultants, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely compliance and accurate tax reporting.

Essential Functions

title: Finance Controller
description:
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Finance Controller to join our team in Maharashtra. The Finance Controller will play a crucial role in overseeing financial operations, ensuring compliance with financial regulations, and providing strategic financial guidance to support the organization's goals. This position is ideal for recent graduates or individuals with limited experience looking to start their career in finance. Key Responsibilities: - Assist in the preparation of financial reports, budgets, and forecasts. - Monitor financial performance and analyze variances against budgets. - Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards. - Support the finance team in daily operations and financial transactions. - Collaborate with other departments to provide financial insights and support decision-making. - Participate in audits and assist in the implementation of financial controls. Required Skills: - Strong understanding of finance principles and practices. - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. - Proficiency in financial software and Microsoft Excel. - Strong attention to detail and accuracy. - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. - Effective communication skills, both written and verbal. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to gain hands-on experience in finance and contribute to the financial success of our organization. If you are passionate about finance and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: MIS Executive
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented MIS Executive to join our team in Maharashtra. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and analyzing data to create insightful reports and dashboards that support decision-making processes within the organization. As an MIS Executive, you will play a crucial role in ensuring that accurate and timely information is available to various departments, enhancing operational efficiency and effectiveness. Key Responsibilities: - Develop and maintain management information systems (MIS) to track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs). - Create and update dashboards that provide real-time insights into business performance. - Collaborate with various departments to gather data and understand their reporting needs. - Analyze data trends and provide actionable insights to management. - Ensure data integrity and accuracy in all reports and dashboards. - Assist in the automation of reporting processes to improve efficiency. - Provide training and support to team members on MIS tools and reporting techniques. Required Skills: - Proficiency in MIS reporting and data analysis. - Experience in creating dashboards and visualizing data. - Familiarity with BPO operations and reporting requirements. - Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. If you are passionate about data and have a knack for turning numbers into actionable insights, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity as an MIS Executive.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Credit Management, Specialist
description:
**Responsibilities**
**Order Release Management:**

* Evaluate and process blocked orders based on customer credit status, outstanding balances, and payment history.
* Liaise with sales, customer service, and finance teams to ensure timely resolution of credit holds and maintain service levels.
* Escalate high-risk cases and recommend alternative solutions to facilitate order release without compromising risk exposure.

**Customer Credit Assessment:**

* Perform in-depth financial analysis and creditworthiness evaluations of new and existing customers.
* Review financial statements, conduct ratio analysis, and utilize external credit rating reports to determine credit limits.
* Continuously monitor customer portfolios and adjust credit lines as needed based on risk profile and market conditions.

**Credit Policy Compliance:**

* Ensure credit decisions comply with internal credit policy and risk tolerance guidelines.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of credit policies and procedures.
* Train and guide internal stakeholders on credit processes and risk awareness.

**Risk Mitigation and Management:**

* Identify customers with elevated risk levels and recommend appropriate risk mitigation tools such as: Credit insurance, Letters of credit, Bank guarantees, Advance payments
* Collaborate with legal and finance teams on drafting and implementing risk protection agreements.

**Reporting And Analysis/Collection Support**

* Generate regular credit risk reports and dashboards for senior management.
* Provide insights and analysis on customer payment behavior, credit utilization and risk trends.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date credit master data in the ERP system.
* Support the collections team by providing credit risk insights and prioritizing high-risk receivables.
* Participate in customer meetings or calls to resolve overdue issues when required.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify process gaps and propose improvements in credit evaluation, monitoring, and risk mitigation.
* Stay up to date on industry best practices, regulatory changes, and economic trends affecting credit risk.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor graduate and/or certificate of completion of job-related courses. Commerce/Finance preferred).
* 4+ of related experience, preferred in SSC/GBS/BPO environment.
* Experience with credit/debt instruments
* English written and verbal communication including ability to interact with all levels throughout the organization.
* SAP experience is mandatory.

**About Us**
Our purpose at Avient Corporation is to be an innovator of materials solutions that help our customers succeed, while enabling a sustainable world.
  
  
Innovation goes far beyond materials science; it’s powered by the passion, creativity, and diverse expertise of 9,000 professionals worldwide. Whether you’re a finance wizard, a tech enthusiast, an operational powerhouse, an HR changemaker, or a trailblazer in materials development, you’ll find your place at Avient.
  
  
Join our global team and help shape the future with sustainable solutions that transform possibilities into realities. Your unique perspective could be the key to our next breakthrough!
  
  
We believe that all of our global employees are leaders and that the six most important behaviors for driving our strategy and culture are the same no matter if an employee is a leader of self, a leader of others, or a leader of the business.
  
  
By
*playing to win, acting customer centric, driving innovation and profitable growth, collaborating seamlessly across Avient, and motivating and inspiring and developing others and yourself*
you will accelerate your ability to achieve Avient’s strategic goals, to meet our customer needs, and to accomplish your career goals.
  
  
At Avient, we believe a wide variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds gives us the creativity to be successful in a rapidly changing world. In support of this, we stress equality of opportunity for all qualified individuals in accordance with applicable laws. Decisions on hiring, promotion, development, compensation or advancement are based solely on a person’s qualifications, abilities, experience and performance.

* Manage the KCC portfolio through continuous monitoring, renewals, retention, and ensuring portfolio hygiene with minimal deferrals and covenant breaches.
* Collaborate with branch banking teams to optimize synergies and work within the broader bank ecosystem.
* Evaluate growth strategies based on competitor analysis and customer feedback.
* Recommend process improvements to enhance service efficiency and quality across the branch network.
* Demonstrate ability in sales planning, promotions, and marketing initiatives.
* Understand financial statements, credit assessment processes, and title/security documentation.

Secondary Responsibilities

* Enable teams to achieve growth targets by providing strategic and operational support.

Education

* Proficiency in credit assessment and financial documentation.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills.

title: F&B Controller
description:
**Job Description**
Job Summary:
  
  
The F&B Controller will be responsible for monitoring food and beverage costs, controlling inventory, analysing consumption, and ensuring efficient cost management across all restaurants, bars, kitchens, and other F&B operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Monitor food and beverage costs, consumption, and operational expenses.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly cost reports and MIS.
* Conduct regular inventory checks and physical stock audits.
* Analyse food costs, beverage costs, wastage, and variances.
* Monitor purchase prices, vendor rates, and adherence to approved budgets.
* Coordinate with the Executive Chef, F&B Operations, Stores, Purchase, and Finance teams.
* Ensure proper control over stock receipts, issues, transfers, and consumption.
* Verify recipe costing, portion control, and menu profitability.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, SOPs, and audit requirements.

**Job Expectations**
Strong knowledge of food and beverage costing, inventory management, and stock audits.
  
  
**Minimum Qualification**
Bachelor's degree in Hotel Management, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
  
  
**Minimum Job Experience**
5–8 years of relevant experience in F&B cost control
  
  
**Reporting To**
Finance Head
  
  
**Travel**
NA Apply Now
